text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Yukino Bijin and I are going to
an
old-fashioned Japanese cafe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This cafe's far too cool for me to visit all
by my
lonesome. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They make these super spiffy sweets
outta rice
crackers, and I've been dy'n to
try 'em!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm already going cuckoo for these rice
crackers,
so let's hurry up and order—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way! You can get a strawb'rry on
top?! And
this one's got choc'late and
whipped cream!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day you get t'come to a
place like
this... which means I gotta try
everything on the
menu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... Ahaha... I guess I got a little
carried
away...
choice_data_list: また付き合うから、無理はしないで
choice_data_list_en: I'll join you again, so don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you'll come with me again, I s'pose I
can just
savor a few!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promise Yukino Bijin that we'll come
again, so
she limits herself to a
reasonable number of
sweets.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Leave it t'me! I'm the best there is at
eat'n rice
crackers!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll start with that green one! I
think it's...
pistachio? Whatever it is, it's
going down the
hatch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin goes on to eat one of every
type of
rice cracker they serve.
